We receive press releases from several feeds, including:BusinessWire PRNewswire GlobeNewswireAccesswireNewMediaWireNewsfileJCN Nasdaq.com’s Dividend History page provides straightforward historical dividends data for stocks. Dividend payout records can be used to gauge the company's long-term performance when analyzing individual stocks.This feature is only available for Nasdaq listed stocks.Historical information is not adjusted for stock splits. Visit our Dividend Calendar. Please note that the dividend history for Nasdaq stocks may also combine the regular dividends with special dividends. Our partner, Quotemedia, provides the upcoming ex-dividend dates for the next month. Please note that the dividend history might include the company’s preferred securities as well. Price/Earnings Ratio is a widely used stock evaluation measure. For a security, the Price/Earnings Ratio is given by dividing the Last Sale Price by the Actual EPS (Earnings Per Share). Nasdaq Official Closing Price (NOCP), which is derived from the closing auction on Nasdaq, reflects actual sale prices at one of the most liquid times of the day. The earnings date is derived from an algorithm based on a company's historical reporting dates and is provided by Zacks Investment Research. In case of any issues with the earnings date, please contact Zacks directly.Visit the Earnings Calendar to see the upcoming and previously reported earnings. Trading information on Nasdaq is provided using real-time data from Nasdaq Data Link. The Nasdaq Indices are delayed at least 1 minute. Mutual Funds are updated at the end of each day. Summary Quote Pages This information helps to understand where the revenue of the company is derived. Source: Quotemedia provides the SIC Code which is then mapped to sector and industry. The Market Cap is a calculated using the Total Shares Outstanding (TSO) multiplied by the current last sale; gives context to the company.Source: Quotemedia utilizes information in the 10K and 10Q SEC Filings. The dividend section reflects historical data and doesn’t project future or upcoming announced dividends (as these are subject to change). The annualized dividend (per share) is a calculated field that takes the last dividend and frequency of the dividend (common frequencies include quarterly or monthly). Current Yield is a value calculated by annualized (per share) dividend current stock price. For Historical and upcoming dividend dates and details, visit the “Dividend History” page per stock.Source: Nasdaq. Regular Market Hours: 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ETPre-Market Trading: 4:00 AM - 9:30 AM ET After-Hours Trading: 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM ET Market Activity Lists & Rankings The Advanced/Declined information is based on the percentage increase/decrease in stock price of Nasdaq Global and Global Select Market securities (and includes warrants and units). The information is updated every minute. https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/most-active Charts & Technical Data The intraday charting service pulls the last sale and volume data for stocks from our data source every minute. Charts are available in multiple time frames including:Intraday (1-minute, 5-minute, 15-minute, hourly intervals)Daily, Weekly, Monthly1-year, 2-year, 5-year, and 10-year historical views Common technical indicators include moving averages, volume, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and other standard technical analysis tools. IPOs & New Listings This field indicates the anticipated initial public offering price range, as filed with the SEC. The actual IPO price may differ from this estimated range. The data is powered by EDGAR® Online LLC, a subsidiary of OTC Markets Group. Expected IPO dates are estimated by EDGAR® Online, which are based on dates in the company’s filings. These expected dates are not official and are not endorsed by Nasdaq.
